audience.title: Built for project and field-service businesses
audience.teamTitle: The team works together — each with the information they need
audience.teamBody: Invite workers and managers and define who manages projects, expenses, changes, and profitability.

items.a: Project, job, and field-service businesses — contractors, renovation, trades, maintenance, and mixed project + service companies.

items.q: Does it also fit a small business?
items.a: Yes. Start with clients, jobs, and basic expenses — without turning everything on.

items.q: Can I manage both projects and service work?
items.a: Yes. Projects, jobs, and work orders can live in the same system — fixed-price or open-price.

items.q: Do I have to use every capability?
items.a: No. Turn on only what you need. A small business stays simple.

items.q: How do I know if a project or job is really profitable?
items.a: You see in one place what it cost, what you are still committed to, what was billed, and what was actually paid — and the real profit. Billed is not paid, and a commitment is not a cost that already happened.

items.q: Can I manage budget versus actuals?
items.a: Yes. Set a budget and see how actual costs compare.

items.q: Can I see how much customers still owe me, and how much I owe vendors?
items.a: Yes. You can see what is still open with customers and with vendors.
No. ProjectFlow manages the work and business profitability, and lets you keep and export information for accounting follow-up.

items.q: Can I manage employees, hours, and attendance?
items.a: Yes. Manage employees, assignments, time, and attendance — and see what the work really costs.

items.q: Can I manage vendors and subcontractors?
items.a: Yes. Vendors, orders, vendor bills, and payments can be linked to the work when you need them.

items.q: Can workers use it from a phone?
items.a: Yes. The same system is adapted for mobile — logs, expenses, and key information stay available in the field.

items.q: Is there planning, forms, photos, and field work?
items.a: Yes. You can plan, record field logs, fill forms, and attach photos and documents.

items.q: Can I install ProjectFlow as an app?
items.a: Yes. Install from the browser to the home screen or desktop when the device supports it.

items.q: Does every worker see financials and profitability?
items.a: No. You set permissions — each person sees what they need.

items.q: How is ProjectFlow different from a task manager?
items.a: A task manager tracks tasks. ProjectFlow connects the work to the money: costs, commitments, billing, and profitability.

items.q: Can I start simple and add capabilities later?
items.a: Yes. Start with the basics and add controls only as the business grows.
